a.lede: The automaker unveiled its next luxury sports car at an event in Texas. It has thrusters on it that can send it airborne.
a.title: The Tesla Roadster 2 Is Here—and It Flies

b.lede: Thrusters are as good at flipping cars as they are at hunting ballistic missiles.
b.title: A 'flying' Tesla Roadster sounds impossible, until you see what Lockheed Martin built decades ago
